title: Artful Deception
story: In a quaint little town, the prestigious 'Art Gallery of Elegance' hosted an exhibition of valuable artworks. Among them was a priceless oil painting by an unknown artist, 'The Enigmatic Masterpiece'. On the opening night, the gallery's owner, Miss Emily, discovered the painting missing from its gilded frame. Time of crime: 8 PM.
crimeScene: The dimly lit Art Gallery of Elegance, adorned with priceless artworks, where 'The Enigmatic Masterpiece' was prominently displayed.
forensicClue: An odd scratch on the surface of the empty frame.
question: Who stole 'The Enigmatic Masterpiece' and why?
options: Option A (The Grumpy Art Appraiser - The appraiser's grumpy demeanor and a habitual grudge against the gallery)
Option B (The Enigmatic Artist - The mysterious artist who asked for anonymity and couldn't provide a fingerprint)
Option C (The Quiet Collector - The collector who visited discreetly and left a cryptic note)
Option D (The Impulsive Student - The student who excitedly shared their art thievery plan the night before)
